name: print-social-dark-green-reading-photo-with-line-callout-quote
title: Dim garden reading photo with a white elbow line leading to a wellness question
whatItIs: A darkened top-down photo of a hand holding an open book with a sprig on a navy gingham skirt over grass. A thin white line rises and bends to a paragraph at the upper right asking about 10 minutes of quiet, with a small wordmark at the top right.
whatItMeans: Quiet and intimate; the single leader line turns a photo into a gentle prompt.
techniques: Use a thin rounded-corner line to link the photo to the text.
Darken the photo so white type is legible.
Keep text in a narrow block at the edge.
Use one asterisk as a bullet.

vocabulary.definition: A line connecting a point in an image to text.
A dim layer over a photo.
A design with very little on it.
